summary: V01-T3-FIX1 已消除 mixed PARTIAL+SUCCESS 恢复泄漏：不可靠邻居被逐条排除，可靠同源上下文仍可有限恢复；无可靠邻居时保持 EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT/Verification REQUIRED。完整兼容回归 390/390 通过，真实 3 文件/2,325-unit 导入、确定性、T1-T4 关键 E2E 与冻结不变量均通过。允许 Orchestrator 建立 V0.1 verified checkpoint。

scope_review.fix_scope: R1 only changes service recovery's per-Evidence quality filtering and adds one mixed-quality regression; T1/T2/T4, filters, recovery actions/round limits and frozen contracts are unchanged.

r1_failure_reverification.mixed_quality_input: same document/section/parent: before-partial(PARTIAL), fragment(SUCCESS), after-good(SUCCESS); query=然后问：; scope=python-learning; top_k=1
r1_failure_reverification.quality_signal_retained: POSSIBLY_INCOMPLETE on original fragment, resolved by bounded context
r1_failure_reverification.assessment: PASS: recovered Evidence is checked individually; unreliable Evidence neither enters final Evidence nor successful recovery trace.

full_regression.environment: Bundled Python 3.12.14; PYTHONPATH=<repo>\src; bundled runtime has no pytest.
full_regression.method: Short-lived read-only compatibility driver imported all 47 test_*.py modules, ran unittest suites and expanded pytest-style plain functions with raises/parametrize/tmp_path/monkeypatch adapters.
full_regression.note: The compatibility driver did not modify repository files. Test count increased by one from the first Gate because the mixed-quality regression is now included.

root_causes_and_repairs.root_cause: Ingestion did not propagate scope and scope-less document Browse was not connected to Source Navigation.
root_causes_and_repairs.repair: Explicit ingest --scope plus unique complete-document navigation over hard-filtered candidates.
root_causes_and_repairs.before: Real Browse blocked for missing scope.
root_causes_and_repairs.after: python-learning Browse returns 2,325; unknown weather scope is OUT_OF_SCOPE/0; FastAI.md navigation without scope returns 733.

root_causes_and_repairs.root_cause: Bare collection/domain words such as 哪些/目录 over-triggered Browse.
root_causes_and_repairs.repair: Browse requires explicit collection-navigation construction; concrete topic questions use Discover.
root_causes_and_repairs.before: Target question was BROWSE and scope-blocked.
root_causes_and_repairs.after: Target question is DISCOVER/NONE and performs retrieval without scope clarification.

root_causes_and_repairs.root_cause: Context-dependent Markdown blocks were valid retrieval units but service did not invoke bounded source recovery; initial repair treated mixed-quality recovered batches atomically.
root_causes_and_repairs.repair: Conservative fragment signal, filtered same-source bounded recovery, per-recovered-Evidence quality filtering and traceable failure when no reliable context exists.
root_causes_and_repairs.before: Isolated transition fragments could appear sufficient; mixed PARTIAL+SUCCESS recovery could leak PARTIAL Evidence with NOT_REQUIRED.
root_causes_and_repairs.after: Real fragment receives same-section context; PARTIAL neighbor is excluded; no-clean path requires Verification; exact Locate remains intact.

root_causes_and_repairs.root_cause: Apply used ordinary retrieval post-processing and equated Source presence with answerability; existing rule/fact/compare chain was bypassed.
root_causes_and_repairs.repair: NOT_REQUIRED only after reliable Rule Structure, required Case facts and deterministic comparison; weak Markdown and incomplete comparisons require Verification.
root_causes_and_repairs.before: Real Apply returned comparison=null with NOT_REQUIRED.
root_causes_and_repairs.after: Real Apply is EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT/rule_structure_unavailable/REQUIRED; explicit synthetic rule is SATISFIED/NOT_REQUIRED; missing fact is INDETERMINATE/case_information_missing/REQUIRED.

unresolved_and_non_goals: Discover ranking/top-k quality remains outside this V0.1 bugfix; the real target was not in this top-10 run.
top_k=20 INVALID_INPUT remains a separate recorded issue and did not affect T1-T4 delivery.
No external embedding/vector service, new reranker, LLM classifier, rule DSL, OCR/PDF/Excel, deployment or distributed authorization was added.
No performance/load/soak or production authorization-provider evaluation was performed.
The fragment quality detector intentionally covers the four observed exact transition fragments; broader linguistic generalization was not added.
